# Processes, Institutions, Values

<!-- STEP id="read-as-table" -->
## One Pattern

Everything in this lesson fits one pattern: a democratic **process** is carried out by **institutions**, and it supports **values**. Tap a process to see this.

Start with the first three: the Legislative, Electoral and Judicial Processes.

<!-- STEP id="wider-than-government" -->
## Beyond the Government

The other four processes reach further. **Civil society** refers to the voluntary groups, NGOs and community associations that function interdependently within society.

**The real strength of democracy lies in its citizens.**
